description: This file defines an in-memory implementation of a DataStore, using Kotlin coroutines and flows. It provides a class `InMemoryDataStore` that maintains an internal mutable state flow and implements the DataStore interface.

classes.name: InMemoryDataStore
classes.description: A generic in-memory implementation of DataStore that holds a mutable state flow for data management.

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Suspend function that transforms the current data and updates the internal state using updateAndGet.
